notes: 0.3.4：内核收敛为单一官方 AutoHotkey 2.0.31 进程外子进程，发行包由 3 个 PE 变 2 个 PE（AutoHotkey64.dll 与 tools\ 退场），合并托盘菜单保留；状态栏与脚本列表的 CPU/GPU/运行内存改为「本体 ＋ 各运行中脚本之和」，列表扩为 7 列（运行/菜单/脚本/CPU/GPU/内存/快捷键）并恢复表头点击排序；内核版本号收为单一参数，关于界面补「内核 AutoHotkey 2.0.31」；门禁补「假绿」防线与内核版本四处一致性断言。
notes_en: 0.3.4: The kernel converges to a single out-of-process official AutoHotkey v2.0.31 child process, and the release shrinks from 3 PEs to 2 PEs (AutoHotkey64.dll and tools\ retired) while keeping the merged tray menu. The status bar and the script list now show CPU/GPU/working-memory as host plus all running scripts; the list grows to 7 columns (run/menu/script/CPU/GPU/memory/hotkey) with header-click sorting restored. The kernel version is now a single parameter, the About dialog gains a 'Kernel AutoHotkey 2.0.31' line, and the gate suite adds a fake-green guard plus a four-way kernel-version consistency assertion.
